frozen: 2026-11-22, by the map's owner's decision ('Yes, do policy v4'), after e103/e104 (tropical convection fixes) had been screened on dev49 and on the open tropical set t, and before any candidate was run on sealed set r. Reason: dev49 holds 4 tropical regions of 49, so it cannot credit a tropical-only fix.
benchmark: scripts/benchmark_local.py --regions dev31 at 56 km: the 19 regions of policy.json plus the 12 predeclared in regions_dev12.json; equal-region means
development_regions: the 49 regions of policy v3 (dev31 + retired a, b, c) plus the open tropical set t (calibration/tropical_check_20261122t/regions.json, 6 regions, used as training data since 22 Nov): 55 regions, all development data.
score: S = 0.5 * T_monthly_mae / T_ref + 0.5 * P_loss / P_ref, equal-region means, reference = current adopted physics on the same code and sources. S55 over all 55 development regions (the gate); S49 over the policy-v3 regions (guard); S_t over set t (reported).
adopt_if: neither T_monthly_mae nor P_loss over the 55 worsens by more than 1 %
guard: S49 not worse (<= 1.0), so the tropics cannot be bought against the rest of the world
paired 28 km check on california, western_europe, japan, new_zealand: S not worse by more than 1 % (<= 1.01)
the next unseen sealed set (now calibration/sealed_20261122r), run once: S not worse (<= 1.0)
group_note: group scores (training, holdout, mid-latitude, dev12, each retired set) are reported but no longer block adoption.
sealed_regions: one unseen set per adopted milestone, run once; once run it joins the development regions.
